expectedBehavior: The packaged Quarkus application (acp-quarkus, JVM mode, quarkus.acp.agent.transport.type=http) is started as a process on a free port and serves an annotated ACP agent (@AcpAgent alone makes it a CDI bean) at /acp on the Quarkus HTTP server. (1) A Streamable HTTP client prints the initialize response JSON it received, with agentInfo name quarkus-streaming-agent, version 1.0.0, title 'Quarkus Streaming Agent', sessionCapabilities.close and promptCapabilities.image true, derived from the annotations (no @Initialize). A greeting prompt shows a thought from a CDI interceptor ('[audit] prompt call #1') and "Hello from Quarkus: you said 'hi over Streamable HTTP'" with end_turn. A 'count to ten' prompt streams a Mutiny Multi: chunk 1, chunk 2, chunk 3 arrive, the client sends session/cancel, and the stop reason is cancelled (a fourth chunk may or may not arrive before the cancel takes effect). A 'status' prompt then reports that the last stream was cancelled after some number of the 10 chunks (3 is typical, 4 is acceptable), seen by the Multi's onCancellation, with end_turn; session/close succeeds. (2) A WebSocket client on the same path and server connects (agentInfo quarkus-streaming-agent, protocol version 1) and gets "Hello from Quarkus: you said 'hi over WebSocket'" with end_turn; the interceptor count continues across connections (call #4). The application is stopped. Ends with '=== Demo Complete ===' and no exceptions, stack traces, or ERROR log lines.
requiredOutput: --- 1. Streamable HTTP on the Quarkus HTTP server ---
thought: [audit] prompt call #1, intercepted by a CDI interceptor
agent: Hello from Quarkus: you said 'hi over Streamable HTTP'
agent: your last stream was cancelled after
--- 2. WebSocket, the same path on the same server ---
agent: Hello from Quarkus: you said 'hi over WebSocket'
thought: [audit] prompt call #4, intercepted by a CDI interceptor
